'''Perth''' was the father of [[Thadius Black]], and father-in-law of [[Kymber Black]]. When Thadius Black smuggled political prisoners away from [[Demophon]], Perth received them on the nearby planet of [[Mowgle]]. When he learned that Thadius Black had been captured he arranged a team to return to Demophon and rescue him.<ref name="I" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[Wikipedia:Perth, Scotland|Perth]] is a city in [[Wikipedia:Scotland|Scotland]], and it has lent its name to other real-life [[Wikipedia:Perth (disambiguation)|items]].
